thread:
incident-bot: Pager: high prefill OOM rate (>12%) on cluster gpu-pool-4 (us-west). Affected svc: redwood-serving-prod, pods: serving-xyz (x ~ 6). Links: <runbook://prefill-oom>
sophie: I'm taking the pager — pulling dmesg + container logs now.
sophie: seeing repeated 'CUDA OOM at prefill for seq_len 16384' on several pods, then container restart loop.
eng-mike: any pattern? model / quantization?
sophie: mostly long-context chat requests, huge system prompts + history. KV cache growth and occasional "kvcache fragmentation" warnings in logs.
ops-lead: can we throttle long-context at the router? set prefill_max_context_tokens=4096 for prod route?
matt: can we hotflip to the quantized variant q4_bf16 for that model — should lower peak mem.
sophie: attempting eviction now — rolled evict-kvcache on affected pods (kubectl exec ... + annotation). monitoring.
sophie: also toggled feature flag to throttle prefill: prefill_max_tokens=4096 (routes overflow to fallback). patch applied.
incident-bot: Metric note: prefill OOM count dropping after eviction + throttle (10m window) — still seeing a handful of restarts.
eng-mike: propose hotpool switch to coldmodel-v1 for very long requests; config snippet:
```
route:
  long_context:
    max_context: 4096
    fallback_model: coldmodel-v1
    quantize: true
```
matt: deploying canary (10%) for fallback route now.
cs-anna: customer impact? anyone seeing 5xx spikes or customer tickets?
sophie: ~180 failed prefill requests in last 10m, two customers reported increased 503s: acme-corp, betaapp. cc'ing product & cs.
pm-lina: prepping customer note. matt, include ETA for full rollback/rollforward and mitigation details.
matt: canary looks stable, OOMs down by ~85%. pushing to 100% in 3m.
sophie: 100% rollout completed. no new OOM restarts in last 5m.
cs-anna: contacted acme-corp and betaapp with interim update; both acknowledged and asked for postmortem.
ops-lead: follow-ups: 1) add prefill RPC size limiter at ingress; 2) surface kvcache fragmentation metric + alert; 3) add automated eviction trigger when kv growth > threshold; 4) schedule load tests with 16k sequences and mixed-history prompts.
sophie: documenting runbook updates in #incidents-postmortems and creating a follow-up ticket.
incident-bot: Incident resolved: prefill OOM surge mitigated, monitoring for 2h. Severity: Sev3. Incident ID: 2026-03-prefill-092
matt: thanks team :thumbsup:
sophie: nice work everyone.
